headline: Leadership Clash at Tata Group Sparks Struggle for Control of Indian Empire
summary: A boardroom battle featuring attempted vetoes and government intervention has erupted at Tata Group, engulfing India's largest conglomerate in a dispute over its strategic direction.
why: Tata Group is India's preeminent business conglomerate, controlling critical listed giants across IT services, automotive manufacturing, and steel production.

impacts.name: Tata Motors Limited
impacts.why: Uncertainty at the parent holding board level risks complicating strategic governance across operating subsidiaries.
